# docs(adrs): record decisions for pull request flow

## Why

Contributors need one place to find the current rules for opening and closing pull requests, as well as how changes land.

## Behavior change

The decision index lists twelve records covering GitHub commands, pull request closure, merge and branch rules, default-branch failures, Renovate, worktrees, cycle time, and the completion and wording rules for pull requests and issues.

## Decisions

- tbhb decided 0001, 0005, 0007 and 0008 on November 11, 2026. Later decisions refined 0001 on November 22 and 23 and 0007 on November 23.
- tbhb decided 0003, 0004, 0006 and 0009 through 0011 on November 22, 2026.
- The coordinating role made the delegated calls for 0002 on November 15, 2026, and 0012 on November 22, 2026.

## Verification

Compared each index entry with its record and checked that each link resolves.
